exercises.why: **боевые** — боево́й: (relational) combat, battle, fighting; (ammunition) live, lethal (as opposed to dummy, blank, or non-lethal); (figurative) militant, bellicose, belligerent; (figurative) active, energetic. Wiktionary: бой + -ево́й.
